message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and calls .info() and .head() for display only; there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or any validation of the loaded data structure.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local CSV files via pd.read_csv with no remote source involved, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code merges label files and drops duplicates but never validates label values against an expected set, checks label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs scaling, encoding, and feature engineering but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models; it only reads CSV data and trains models from scratch, so no integrity verification is applicable or implemented.
No detected label distribution validation: The code performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection on the labels before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection of any kind in this training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolated held-out test set, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; cross-validation is present but no isolation or integrity controls are evident.
No detected input sanitization: The code only performs training-time preprocessing (drop_duplicates, feature engineering, scaling) with no validation or sanitization of incoming inference requests.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model outputs such as probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation are present in the visible code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular ML pipeline (LinearRegression/LogisticRegression), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
